step1_figure.description: Figure 26.19 depicts the fully-differential cascode diff-amp biased with Vbiasn and Vbiasp generated from Figure 26.3. Figure 26.20 shows the common-mode simulation configuration where the differential inputs are tied together to VCM and swept from 400 mV to 600 mV to observe common-mode output sensitivity.

output_cm_voltage.description: Common-mode output voltage (vop + vom)/2 at the nominal input common-mode voltage VCM = 500 mV

equation.explanation: At nominal common-mode input VCM = 500 mV, the output quiescent level is set by the cascode load and mirrors Vbiasp (~600 mV in the 1V design).
equation.assumptions: Differential inputs balanced and biased at nominal common-mode level VCM = 500 mV.

sky130_expected.calculation: In SKY130 with VDD = 1.8 V, the wide-swing bias circuit (SUB_1) sets Vbiasn ≈ Vthn + Vovn ≈ 0.42 V + 0.2 V = 0.62 V, and Vbiasp ≈ VDD - (|Vthp| + Vovp) ≈ 1.8 V - 0.6 V = 1.2 V. The output common-mode voltage settles around Vbiasp ≈ 1.05 V - 1.25 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Output nodes are set by the current balance between the cascoded PMOS current sources and NMOS input/cascode branches.

cm_voltage_gain.description: Common-mode voltage gain from input VCM to output common-mode voltage

equation.explanation: Baker notes: 'A 200 mV change in the common-mode voltage results in a, roughly, 50 mV change in the diff-amp common-mode output voltages', giving Acm ≈ -50 mV / 200 mV = -0.25.
equation.assumptions: VCM swept between 400 mV and 600 mV.

sky130_expected.calculation: |Acm| = |ΔVout / ΔVin| ≈ 50 mV / 200 mV = 0.25 (-12 dB). For short-channel MOSFETs in SKY130, finite output resistance of tail current source yields Acm ≈ -0.2 to -0.35.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Consistent with Baker's reported sensitivity of ~50 mV change per 200 mV input common-mode change.

delta_vout_cm.description: Total change in diff-amp common-mode output voltage across the 200 mV VCM sweep range (400 mV to 600 mV)

equation.explanation: Quantifies the total shift in output common-mode operating point over the input common-mode range.
equation.assumptions: Linear response over 400 mV to 600 mV input common-mode range.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker explicitly derives and plots roughly 50 mV change in Fig. 26.20.

quiescent_power.description: Total DC power dissipation of the cascode diff-amp and bias generator under quiescent condition (VCM = 500 mV)

equation.explanation: Total static current drawn by the cascode diff-amp core (3 vertical branches: ~20 uA each = 60 uA) plus the wide-swing bias generator (~80 uA).
equation.assumptions: Nominal VDD = 1.8 V and VCM = 500 mV.

sky130_expected.calculation: IDD ≈ 120 uA to 180 uA across diff-amp branches and bias generator. Pdiss = 1.8 V * 150 uA ≈ 270 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of currents through all branches from VDD to ground at nominal DC operating point.

step3_testbench.description: SPICE testbench sweeping VCM from 400 mV to 600 mV to measure output common-mode voltage, common-mode voltage gain, and quiescent power dissipation.
